erpOrder.title: ERP order
erpOrder.sub: What the ERP has for this order. Shown only when the store speaks ERP contract v6.

held.ACCOUNT_ON_HOLD: Waiting: the ERP account is on hold. It goes by itself when the ERP releases the account.
held.INSUFFICIENT_STOCK: Waiting: the ERP is short of stock. It goes again by itself when the stock is there.
held.NO_SHOP_PRICE: Waiting: a SKU has no shop price at the ERP yet. That SKU is not sold until it has one.
held.LINE_WAITING: Waiting: a line is short. The shipment goes once the line is decided or filled.

hold.on: The ERP account is on hold: new orders wait and checkout is paused until the ERP releases it.
hold.onOpen: The ERP account is on hold: new orders wait. Checkout stays open (the pause switch is off).
hold.warn: The ERP will hold new orders on {date} ({days} days left) unless a payment reaches it.
hold.noShopPrice: Not sold: the ERP has no shop price yet for {skus}. Set the shop price in the ERP. They sell again when the ERP takes an order with them, or after the wait when no order is waiting for them.

ident.YELLOW: Yellow · count and value certain, colour or size not
ident.ORANGE: Orange · unclear, the parcel goes on Hold

lines.title: Pieces at the ERP
lines.fromReturnHelp: This piece came back from a customer; it is checked at packing.

short.RETURN_PIECE_FAILED_CHECK: The Return-stock piece failed the packing check.
short.other: The ERP cannot fill this line now.

decide.title: This line waits for your decision
decide.skuHint: Checked for stock and priced at its shop price today.

err.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission for this.
err.INVALID_INPUT: Something in the form is not right.
err.CONFLICT: This line is no longer waiting.
err.NOT_FOUND: This order is not at the ERP.
err.other: It did not work. Try again.
